_comment: Keys whose value must CONTAIN the listed substring(s), byte-for-byte, in every locale — not be identical to English. The app's own frontend code detects a specific failure by testing the exact substring below (see each site cited), so translating that fragment silently breaks the feature; everything else in the value is free to translate normally. check.mjs enforces this: a locale whose value for one of these keys is missing a required substring fails, naming the key and the missing text. Substrings were copied verbatim from the frontend call sites, not retyped from memory:

errors.ssh.fileTooLarge.reason: frontend/src/components/SFTPFileEditorModal.tsx does `msg.includes("file too large")` to offer the "open with system editor" fallback for an oversized remote file.

errors.ssh.binaryFile.reason: frontend/src/components/SFTPFileEditorModal.tsx does `msg.includes("binary file")` to detect a binary remote file and skip the text editor.

errors.agents.providerSessionMissing.reason: frontend/src/components/terminal/agentRestore.ts does `.toLowerCase().includes("provider conversation is unavailable")` to detect an unresumable agent session and offer the restore-from-scratch fallback.

errors.agents.providerSessionNotFound.reason: Same detection as errors.agents.providerSessionMissing above — frontend/src/components/terminal/agentRestore.ts matches on this exact phrase regardless of which of the two keys produced the error.

errors.vcruntime.redistNotInstalled.reason: frontend/src/components/VcRedistModal.tsx's REDIST_PROBE constant is matched via `msg.includes(REDIST_PROBE)` in NewProjectModal.tsx and Dashboard.tsx to offer the install-redistributable prompt. Dashboard.tsx also runs `e.message.match(/^([^:]+\.exe)/)` to recover the binary name from the front of the message — a translation must not add text (or a colon) before the "{{binary}}" placeholder's rendered value.
